_comment: Golden vectors for the Guts declaration guide. Two implementations read this file: internal/domain/Guts_test.go (GutsEvaluateGuide) and frontend/src/utils/gutsGuideUtils.golden.test.ts (evaluateGutsGuide). Changing the guide rules on one side alone fails that side; regenerating these numbers to fix it fails the other. suit: 1=Spade 2=Clover 3=Heart 4=Diamond. A low ace (value 1) ranks 14.

cases.name: a pair of twos is still the strong tier
ace high is medium (the low ace ranks 14, not 1)
queen high is low (the boundary is the king)
a jack high is low even though the CPU would stay on it
